verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a dedicated rate-limits page (uncached TPM limits, cache hit rate effects) and pricing page notes tiered scaling ('10x higher rate limits than free tier', self-serve vs free vs partner access), plus a models page pointing to 'per-tier limits.' However, the evidence never shows concrete numeric RPM/TPM figures per tier, and community reports (e.g., hitting RPM limits instantly) suggest limits are not always clear in practice. Missing for 10: explicit numeric rate-limit tables per tier, independent confirmation that documented limits match real-world behavior.
